study_identification_part.si_4_title: Extreme deviations from the normative model reveal cortical heterogeneity and associations with negative symptom severity in first-episode psychosis from the OPTiMiSE and GAP studies

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model built using a federated, hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR) approach. The model was adapted to clinical sites using the PCNtoolkit. Sex and scanner site were included as batch effects (similar to levels in multi-level modelling).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model predicting cortical thickness from age. This model was built from healthy participant data (n = 37,126) across 79 scanners... Participant sex and scanner site have been accounted for in the model by inclusion as batch effects which can be interpreted as levels in multi-level modelling; built using a federated, hierarchical Bayesian regression approach across a population of multi-site MRI data; All code for the estimation of the normative models is available online (https://github.com/amarquand/PCNtoolkit)
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Worker2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modelling and statistical analysis

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness was calculated for 148 regions of the Destrieux atlas using FreeSurfer version 6.0.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: T1-weighted brain magnetic resonance images from the GAP and OPTiMiSE samples were processed with Freesurfer V6.0.0 yielding 148 cortical thickness features; For each of the 148 regions of the Destrieux atlas, cortical thickness was calculated and extracted.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Worker2023.pdf.md: Abstract; Methods / Image acquisition and processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model predicted cortical thickness from age, with sex and scanner site accounted for as batch effects in the hierarchical Bayesian model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model predicting cortical thickness from age; Participant sex and scanner site have been accounted for in the model by inclusion as batch effects which can be interpreted as levels in multi-level modelling, enabling nuisance variance related to site and sex to be removed.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Worker2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modelling and statistical analysis
